statement_blocker: The catalog gives no source edition, formula, or definition chain and does not select the closed, smooth-boundary, or corner-corrected Gauss-Bonnet theorem. It also leaves the surface model, regularity, compactness, connectedness, orientability, curvature and measure conventions, Euler-characteristic representation, ordered binders, hypotheses, conclusion, and exceptional cases open. Selecting a standard modern formula would add proposition-changing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Prospective objects include a compact Riemannian two-manifold or embedded regular surface, possibly with smooth or piecewise-smooth boundary, its Gaussian curvature and area measure, optional signed boundary geodesic curvature and corner angles, and a source-selected topological Euler characteristic. Exact universes, manifold model, structures, instances, coercions, and regularity remain open.
conclusion: Open: the repository describes a relationship between total curvature and topology but supplies no truth-valued formula or selected boundary variant.
candidate_statement_shape_not_credited: For a source-selected compact surface class, equate the source-normalized Gaussian-curvature integral, together with any required boundary and corner terms, to the source-normalized Euler characteristic. The domain, terms, conventions, and exact formula are not yet selected.

candidate_formulations_not_credited.target: For a compact surface region with piecewise-smooth boundary, add the source-convention exterior-angle sum to the curvature terms and obtain 2 * pi * chi(M).
